spinos.hom.

page.notes: The number before the 38th thesis is printed "XXXIIX" (sequence error for XXXVIII); left as printed. "volut", "Neq;", "substatia", "quastiones" and "qua" before "in-de" are doubtful readings, marked [?]. The Greek word in XXXIV ("φιλοσοφήματα") is partly unclear; marked [?]. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page with "suæ" and continues on the next page. "Intelligentia" and "p.partium" are written whole as printed line-breaks show no hyphen.
